panels.title: Article 79 architecture, composition and representation
ascii_lines: Article 79 creates one Parliament from the President and two differently constituted Houses.
President + Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha combine assent, popular mandate and federal revision.
President is integral to Parliament but is not a member of either House.
